title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Maintaining National Financial Security and Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Economic Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Protection and Legal Services for Maintaining National Financial Security and the Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Development of the Economy

Fa Fa [2008] No. 38

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Protection and Legal Services for Maintaining National Financial Security and the Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Development of the Economy are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

December 3, 2008

Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Protection and Legal Services for Maintaining National Financial Security and the Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Development of the Economy

Finance is the core of the modern economy and plays an important role in the state's implementation of macroeconomic regulation, promotion of national economic development, and maintenance of social stability. The international financial market turmoil and world economic recession triggered by the U.S. "subprime mortgage crisis" in August 2007 are increasingly having a significant impact on China's financial markets and economic growth. To this end, the State Council has vigorously introduced a series of measures to expand domestic demand, combining a proactive fiscal policy with a moderately loose monetary policy, offsetting the weakening of exports through expanding domestic demand, and revitalizing the slowing economy through large-scale public investment. This series of measures is not only an urgent need for China to maintain financial stability and comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development, but also an important strategic measure adopted by China to curb the world economic recession. At the same time, new situations and problems requiring high attention have emerged in China's economic operation over the thirty years of reform and opening up. Conflicts and disputes arising from changes in the international and domestic macroeconomic environment have clearly manifested in the judicial field. The various adjudication work of the people's courts is closely related to national economic development and the overall situation of social stability. Under the current circumstances of changes in the international and domestic macroeconomic environment and increasing social conflicts, providing judicial protection and legal services for maintaining national financial security and stable and relatively fast economic development is an important task for the people's courts in the current and future period to implement the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, study and practice the Scientific Outlook on Development, and adhere to the guiding principle of "Three Supremes." People's courts at all levels must further enhance their sense of political responsibility, increase their sensitivity to the various new situations and problems triggered by changes in the macroeconomic situation in the judicial field, submit to and serve the overall situation of the state in preventing financial risks, maintaining financial security, and ensuring national economic stability, conscientiously fulfill the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, give full play to the adjudicative functions of the people's courts, firmly grasp the initiative in responding to new situations and problems brought by the macroeconomic environment, and provide strong judicial protection and high-quality legal services for maintaining national financial security and promoting comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development.

I. Lawfully Protect Financial Creditors' Rights and Strive to Maintain National Financial Security

Finance is the lifeblood of the national economy, and state-owned banks are the center of finance. People's courts at all levels must fully understand the complexity of the current international financial situation and the difficulties facing domestic economic development, consciously submit to the overall situation of national economic development, assume the responsibility of protecting financial creditors' rights and maintaining national financial security, support financial regulatory agencies in effectively exercising their management functions, and ensure the smooth implementation of the state's macroeconomic control objectives.

Maximum protection shall be given to state-owned financial creditors' rights. To reduce and dispose of non-performing assets of state-owned commercial banks and ensure their competitiveness and solvency, the central government and the State Council have implemented a strategy for stripping and disposing of non-performing financial assets. From the second half of 1999 to date, the four state-owned banks (Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, and China Construction Bank) have stripped a total of over two trillion yuan in non-performing financial assets. Recently, to accelerate its restructuring, the Agricultural Bank of China has stripped another over 800 billion yuan in non-performing financial assets. People's courts nationwide shall continue to adjudicate relevant cases in accordance with the spirit and provisions of judicial interpretations and judicial policies such as the Provisions on Certain Issues concerning the Adjudication of Cases Arising from the Acquisition, Management, and Disposal of Non-performing Loans of State-owned Banks by Financial Asset Management Companies, providing judicial protection for the recovery of state-owned financial creditors' rights. At the same time, people's courts at all levels shall, within the scope of law and judicial interpretations, protect state-owned financial creditors' rights to the maximum extent in important aspects such as contract validity and the statute of limitations.

Efforts shall be made to prevent the loss of state-owned assets. When handling disputes over the transfer of non-performing financial creditors' rights, attention shall be paid to preventing the loss of state-owned assets. The stripping and disposal of trillions of state-owned financial creditors' rights is by no means a simple creditor-debtor transfer relationship between banks, financial asset management companies, and transferees, but an issue of the flow and redistribution of interests of huge state-owned assets. Whether such flow can be conducted under open, fair, and impartial procedures concerns the interests of all citizens and the state, and the smooth realization of the goals of China's financial system reform and even the reform of the state-owned asset management system. When adjudicating relevant cases, people's courts at all levels shall reasonably allocate the burden of proof and examine relevant evidence. The focus of examination shall revolve around various restrictive and prohibitive provisions formulated by relevant state competent authorities regarding the transfer of non-performing financial creditors' rights, such as the subject matter of the transfer, transfer procedures, and the qualifications of the transferee, to prevent recovery lawsuits from becoming a tool for a few lawbreakers to reap huge profits and to ensure the safety of state-owned assets.

Acts of evading bank debt obligations shall be sanctioned according to law. When adjudicating financial dispute cases, the responsibilities of both the lender and the borrower shall be strictly examined and determined, and acts that circumvent the law through litigation, such as attempting to evade or eliminate debts, shall be resolutely stopped according to law. For those engaging in fraud and taking advantage of the situation to evade debts, the corresponding legal liability of the parties and responsible persons shall be pursued to maintain credit order. For the phenomenon of "false bankruptcy, true debt evasion" in some enterprise bankruptcy cases, people's courts at all levels shall take active and effective measures, resolutely resist interference from local protectionism, increase sanctions against "debt evasion" according to law, and strive to eliminate the phenomenon of evading or suspending debts under the guise of bankruptcy.

II. Sanction Financial Illegal and Non-compliant Acts and Vigorously Rectify and Standardize Financial Order

Maintaining a good financial operation order and environment and promoting coordinated financial development are important aspects of revitalizing the economy and maintaining financial security. People's courts at all levels shall cooperate with financial regulatory authorities to severely crack down on and sanction various illegal and non-compliant acts disrupting financial order, providing strong legal protection for standardizing financial order, preventing financial risks, and maintaining social stability.

Financial criminal activities shall be severely cracked down on. People's courts at all levels shall fully utilize their criminal adjudication functions to severely crack down on criminal acts in the financial field. Cases of crimes disrupting the order of the financial market economy shall be adjudicated in a timely manner according to law, and efforts shall be made to recover national economic losses. In accordance with the spirit of the State Council's Provisions on the Transfer of Suspected Criminal Cases by Administrative Law Enforcement Organs, the adjudication force shall be adjusted and strengthened, close cooperation with relevant departments shall be maintained, the policy of severely punishing according to law shall be implemented, and the deepening of the work to rectify and standardize market economic order shall be promoted.

Financial non-compliant acts shall be sanctioned according to law. Acts by some private institutions and enterprises that disrupt normal national financial order by absorbing public deposits in disguised form through high interest rates or illegal fund-raising shall be prevented. Criminal acts of illegally absorbing public deposits, targeting an unspecified majority as fund-raising targets and using high interest as bait, shall be cracked down on according to law. During the adjudication and enforcement of loan and private lending cases, where suspicion of illegal fund-raising or criminal clues are found, active communication with relevant functional departments shall be made, and the case or criminal clues shall be transferred in a timely manner. Multiple means shall be used to strengthen the recovery and pursuit of raised funds, and the lawful rights and interests of creditors shall be protected in a timely manner according to law. Contingency plans for handling emergencies shall be formulated to prevent a small number of lawbreakers from inciting or organizing mass incidents that may trigger new social conflicts.

The stable operation of the securities market shall be ensured. The stable operation and healthy development of the securities market directly affect financial order and social stability. Currently, illegal acts such as stock price manipulation, insider trading, and false statements by some securities institutions, listed companies, and investment institutions occur from time to time. People's courts at all levels shall, starting from the protection of the lawful rights and interests of securities market investors and the maintenance of an open, fair, and impartial trading order in the securities market, actively explore and properly handle such cases. Disputes over company stock and bond trading, government bond trading, corporate bond issuance, securities agency and underwriting agreements, securities repurchase contracts, and listed company acquisitions shall be properly adjudicated to ensure the safe conduct of securities trading.

Coordination and cooperation with financial regulatory authorities shall be strengthened, and attention shall be paid to preventing systemic risks. During the adjudication of company cases, where people's courts at all levels discover that listed companies or intermediary institutions have engaged in false disclosures or unreasonable valuations, the relevant circumstances shall be promptly reported to financial regulatory authorities to increase the transparency of information disclosure by listed companies and accounting and other intermediary institutions, enhance the disclosure of complex financial product information by accounting institutions, and strengthen the reasonable valuation of securities by intermediary institutions. When adjudicating private lending cases and debt dispute cases involving enterprises with broken capital chains, where illegal acts such as suspected illegal deposit absorption are discovered, or where there is a possibility of triggering systemic risks, the situation shall be promptly reported to public security, procuratorial, financial regulatory, and industry and commerce departments, and the handling and risk prevention of related cases shall be coordinated as a whole.

III. Lawfully Protect Enterprise Development and Make Every Effort to Maintain Social Harmony and Stability

People's courts at all levels shall further deepen their understanding of the importance of protecting enterprise development, promoting state-owned enterprise reform, and maintaining enterprise stability. Only when enterprises are invigorated can the market be invigorated; only when enterprises develop can the economy develop; only when enterprises are stable can society be further stable. All types of cases concerning enterprise reform, development, and stability shall be adjudicated fairly and promptly. New ways to serve enterprise reform and development shall be actively explored, enterprises shall be guided to manage according to law, and the legal awareness and self-protection awareness of enterprises shall be enhanced, creating a favorable legal environment for enterprise reform and development.

Enterprise debt dispute cases shall be adjudicated properly. Currently, when adjudicating enterprise debt dispute cases, special attention shall be paid to disputes arising from broken capital chains. Work methods shall reflect the unity of principle and flexibility. For indebted enterprises that are still in normal operation, have development prospects, but lack funds, property preservation measures shall be used with caution. Patient and meticulous mediation efforts shall be made to creditors, and through flexible and diverse methods such as setting up guarantees, creditors shall be facilitated in granting debtors a reasonable grace period to help them overcome temporary financial crises. For cases where multiple creditors apply for enforcement against the same indebted enterprise in different courts simultaneously, the higher people's court shall strengthen coordination, unify enforcement measures, and at the same time, pay attention to enforcement mediation, striving as much as possible to maintain the survival of distressed enterprises with development prospects and labor-intensive small and medium-sized enterprises, avoiding the intensification of social conflicts due to simplistic enforcement measures, and preventing new conflicts and disputes arising from the distribution of the available property of the judgment debtor.

Company liquidation cases shall be adjudicated properly. In accordance with the provisions of the Company Law and its judicial interpretations, company liquidation cases shall be accepted actively and prudently, the lawful rights and interests of creditors and shareholders shall be equally protected, the liquidation obligations of investors shall be strengthened, and the civil liability of investors who neglect to perform liquidation obligations and harm the interests of creditors shall be pursued according to law, ensuring a standardized and orderly market exit process and promoting the continuous optimization of the market rule-of-law environment.

Enterprise bankruptcy cases shall be accepted and adjudicated properly. The role of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law in fairly protecting the interests of all parties and achieving optimal resource allocation shall be fully utilized. For enterprises that have already met the bankruptcy causes stipulated in the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law, compulsory liquidation procedures and enterprise bankruptcy procedures shall be initiated promptly according to law upon the application of the parties concerned. For enterprises with a chance of rescue, the use of bankruptcy reorganization and composition systems shall be encouraged, and the survival of enterprises with development prospects shall be maintained as much as possible, avoiding a chain of social reactions caused by enterprise bankruptcy, such as large-scale layoffs, unfulfilled bank claims, and social instability. For enterprises that must go bankrupt due to industrial structure transformation and dim operating prospects, adjudication efficiency shall be improved and bankruptcy costs reduced on the basis of ensuring openness, fairness, and legality. For enterprises with many outstanding issues such as arrears of workers' wages, social insurance, heavy historical burdens, and no hope of rescue, worker claims shall be given priority protection in accordance with the provisions of the new Bankruptcy Law. The administrator shall be supported in recovering the claims of the bankrupt enterprise, recovering assets transferred or concealed by the bankrupt enterprise, and striving to increase the claim settlement rate.

IV. Lawfully Standardize Economic Order and Promote Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Economic Development

The fundamental purpose of lawfully standardizing economic order is to improve the socialist market economy system and promote comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable national economic development. People's courts at all levels shall, through effectively carrying out the adjudication of all types of cases, ensure economic system reform and maintain and improve the market economic order.

Various litigation remedies shall be strengthened. New demands and expectations for judicial work shall be actively responded to, disputes arising from changes in the macroeconomic environment shall be accepted promptly, and the ability of litigation procedures to resolve various social conflicts shall be maximized to maintain social stability. For enterprises with the intention to transfer assets or evade debts, litigation preservation measures shall be strengthened. For applications for pre-litigation or in-litigation preservation measures submitted by creditors, the review process shall be completed in the shortest possible time, and measures such as freezing, sealing, and seizure shall be implemented as soon as possible to effectively control the property of the sued enterprise, preventing acts that seriously harm the interests of creditors and workers, such as transferring effective assets after being sued by the debt enterprise. For shareholders and senior management personnel of the debt enterprise who may abscond, measures such as border controls shall be taken promptly according to law upon the application of the parties concerned to effectively control them, preventing the impact of the debtor's flight on the adjudication of the case and the effective control of the debt enterprise's property.

State-owned assets shall be protected from infringement. Crimes such as grabbing, stealing, destroying, or intentionally damaging the means of production and equipment of state-owned enterprises shall be severely cracked down on, especially theft crimes against state-owned enterprises, to protect the assets of state-owned enterprises. Crimes of duty such as embezzlement, bribery, as well as crimes of embezzling, misappropriating, or defrauding state-owned enterprise funds and property shall be severely punished according to law. Penalties such as property-related punishments shall be fully utilized to recover economic losses for the state to the maximum extent, protect state-owned assets from infringement, and maintain normal ownership relations over public and private property.

The development of the non-public sector of the economy shall be protected according to law. The individual and private sectors of the non-public economy are important forces in promoting the development of social productivity. China's Property Law clearly stipulates that the state upholds and improves the basic economic system under which public ownership is dominant and multiple forms of ownership develop together, ensuring the consolidation and development of the public sector of the economy, encouraging, supporting, and guiding the development of the non-public sector of the economy, and protecting the lawful rights and interests of the state, collectives, and individuals. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the provisions and spirit of the Property Law and other laws, actively promote joint ventures and cooperation between the non-public sector and the state-owned sector through judicial means, encourage the non-public sector to enter infrastructure, public utilities, and other industries and fields not prohibited by laws and regulations, and ensure that non-public enterprises enjoy equal treatment with other enterprises in terms of investment and financing, taxation, land use, and foreign trade, ensuring the healthy development of the non-public economy and promoting social progress.

The lawful rights and interests of foreign investors shall be protected according to law. With the increasing degree of China's reform and opening up, the adjudication tasks of various foreign-related cases facing the people's courts will also increase accordingly. People's courts at all levels shall carefully study professional issues, commercial practices, maritime rules, and the application of foreign laws and international conventions in foreign-related cases. The lawful rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties shall be protected equally, the international reputation and image of opening up of the Chinese government and enterprises shall be maintained, and the deepening of opening up shall be promoted. At the same time, an emergency adjudication mechanism for dealing with illegal withdrawal of capital and debt evasion by domestic enterprises and foreign-invested enterprises shall be established, and contingency plans for personnel control, property and evidence preservation, and stabilization of workers and creditors shall be prepared. The liability of investors for capital contribution defects and liquidation liability shall be pursued according to law to protect the lawful rights and interests of creditors.

The healthy development of the real estate market shall be protected according to law. The development of the real estate market is not only related to China's urbanization and industrialization process but also to issues of national importance such as financial security and the people's well-being. People's courts at all levels shall pay attention to examining the authenticity of mortgage loan contracts, sanctioning according to law illegal acts such as developers using false mortgage loan contracts to obtain bank funds; giving priority protection to the legitimate rights and interests of workers in the construction market according to law, sanctioning the malicious withholding of labor wages; and sanctioning developers' breach of contract such as malicious arrears of project funds, ensuring the healthy development of the real estate market.

V. Promote the Lawful Administration by the Government and Ensure the Unified Implementation of Laws and Policies

Maintaining financial security and promoting comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development require the government to further transform its economic management functions. People's courts at all levels shall, through carrying out effective administrative adjudication work, strengthen supervision over administrative law enforcement activities and promote law-based administration.

Local protectionism, regional blockades, and departmental and industry monopolies shall be curbed according to law. Local protectionism, regional blockades, and departmental and industry monopolies seriously hinder the formation of a unified, fair competition socialist market across the country and are an important cause of disorder in the market economy order. People's courts at all levels shall fully utilize the role of administrative and civil adjudication to resolutely curb local protectionism, regional blockades, and departmental and industry monopolies. For administrative cases arising from the rectification of local protectionism, regional blockades, and departmental and industry monopolies, the rectification actions of administrative organs shall be supported according to law. For administrative and civil lawsuits filed by citizens, legal persons, and other organizations whose fair competition rights are infringed upon by local protectionism, regional blockades, or departmental and industry monopolies, their fair competition rights shall be protected according to law.

The adjudication of administrative cases such as land acquisition and demolition shall be strengthened. In the process of implementing the four trillion yuan stimulus measures to boost domestic demand and strengthen infrastructure construction, rural land acquisition and urban house demolition are inevitable. People's courts at all levels shall do a good job in adjudicating administrative litigation cases concerning land acquisition and demolition. While supporting the government's reasonable administrative acts of land acquisition and demolition to ensure the improvement and perfection of public facilities, situations where the lawful rights and interests of the masses and enterprises are harmed under the pretext of land acquisition and demolition shall be prevented, and large-scale mass incidents affecting social stability caused by improper case adjudication shall be avoided.

Administrative organs shall be urged to perform their statutory duties according to law. The failure of administrative organs to perform their statutory duties, such as failing to approve what should be approved, failing to stop what should be stopped, and failing to punish what should be punished, is an important manifestation of failure to abide by the law, lax law enforcement, and failure to investigate illegal acts. People's courts at all levels shall actively accept and adjudicate various types of administrative nonfeasance cases according to law, and urge the sued administrative organs to perform their statutory duties according to law. For administrative lawsuits filed by citizens, legal persons, or other organizations against administrative organs for failing to fulfill their legal duty to protect fair competition rights, and those requiring the competent administrative organs to pursue the legal liability of counterfeiters and sellers of fake goods according to law, due to the nonfeasance of the competent administrative organs, such cases shall be adjudicated in a timely and impartial manner according to law. If losses are caused to citizens, legal persons, or other organizations, the administrative organs shall be ordered to provide compensation according to law.

VI. Strengthen Intellectual Property Protection and Implement the National Intellectual Property Strategy

Enhancing the capacity for independent innovation and building an innovative country are the primary tasks for promoting sound and rapid development of the national economy. The people's courts bear significant responsibilities in the implementation of the National Intellectual Property Strategy. People's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the requirement set forth in the National Intellectual Property Strategy Outline to "give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights," effectively increase the punishment of intellectual property infringements in accordance with the law, effectively curb infringements, and maintain a fair competitive market order and the legitimate rights and interests of the public.

It is essential to fully recognize the major strategic significance of rejuvenating the country through science and education. Relying on scientific and technological progress and innovation to form a batch of key technologies and brand-name products with independent intellectual property rights is an important guarantee for ensuring comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable development of the national economy. The people's courts must further fully recognize the major strategic significance of rejuvenating the country through science and education, respect knowledge, respect talent, and increase judicial protection of intellectual property rights. As China comprehensively promotes the optimization and upgrading of its industrial structure, the introduction and application of various new technologies will inevitably accelerate. Various enterprises, especially large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, will assume more roles as industrializers and implementers of technical solutions, which will help solve the employment problem of a large labor force, promote the development of regional economies, and create substantial social wealth. Therefore, the people's courts must further strengthen judicial protection at both the stage of formation of technical solutions and the stage of their industrialization, effectively protect the intellectual property rights of enterprises in accordance with the law, and promote the growth of social wealth.

Scientific and technological innovation activities must be protected in accordance with the law. With the development of high technologies such as information technology and biotechnology, cases related to the development and application of high technologies, as well as new types of cases, continue to emerge. The scope of intellectual property adjudication in China has now covered various fields, including technology contracts, trade secrets, trademarks, patents, copyrights, computer software, computer networks, databases, domain names, unfair competition, monopolies, new plant varieties, and other scientific and technological achievements. People's courts at all levels must strictly and conscientiously follow the requirements of the National Intellectual Property Strategy Outline, give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and in accordance with the provisions of laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, establish and improve the intellectual property adjudication system and judicial principles in areas such as case jurisdiction, review of applications for interim measures before filing a lawsuit, procedures for suspension of litigation, determination of the scope of intellectual property rights, and infringement identification. The intellectual achievements of scientific and technical personnel and authors must be protected in accordance with the law, and various judicial remedies and civil sanctions, such as ordering cessation of infringement, removal of obstructions, elimination of dangers, and compensation for losses, must be adopted to stop and sanction acts of infringement, counterfeiting, and piracy. Through the handling of these disputes, the legitimate rights and interests of intellectual property holders must be effectively protected, the dissemination of knowledge and culture promoted, public interests safeguarded, scientific and technological innovation activities protected, and the occurrence of acts of abuse of intellectual property rights prevented.

VII. Intensify Enforcement of Judgments to Solve Difficulties for the Government and Enterprises

People's courts at all levels must further fully implement the Zhongfa [1999] No. 11 document, and in accordance with the requirement of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China to "effectively solve the difficulty in enforcement," deepen reforms, improve measures, and advance despite difficulties, striving to enable court enforcement work to play a greater role in ensuring financial security and serving comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development.

Special centralized enforcement activities for outstanding financial cases must continue to be carried out. Under the guidance and deployment of the Supreme People's Court, people's courts at all levels shall, through methods such as concentrating time, concentrating forces, unified deployment, strengthening efforts, and establishing special enforcement organizations, combined with the centralized clearance of backlog enforcement cases, carry out special enforcement of financial cases in a planned manner, solving difficulties for the state and enterprises, and enhancing the rule-of-law concept and risk awareness in finance across the whole society.

New enforcement methods must be explored and the intensity of enforcement of financial cases must be increased. People's courts at all levels must strive to explore and apply new enforcement measures and methods, continuously increase the intensity of enforcement of financial cases, and ensure the smooth enforcement of financial cases. Methods proven effective in practice, such as using asset use rights to offset debts, asset offset debts with leaseback, overall contractual operation of enterprises, conversion of creditor's rights into equity, and trusteeship, must continue to be used to vigorously resolve difficult financial dispute cases. At the same time, judgment debtors who fail to repay debts should be appropriately disclosed, and active cooperation should be provided in establishing a social credit system.

A unified coordination mechanism for the adjudication and enforcement of series cases must be established. For series litigation cases where numerous creditors initiate concentrated lawsuits against the same debtor enterprise, courts of different regions and different instances, as well as different adjudication departments within the same court, must strengthen information communication. Under the unified guidance of a higher-level court, they shall centrally coordinate, centrally adjudicate, and coordinate enforcement, avoiding situations where different courts adopt inconsistent adjudication standards for similar cases against the same debtor enterprise, and avoiding conflicts and contradictions in enforcement among multiple cases against the same debtor enterprise, thereby equally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of creditors in various regions in accordance with the law.

Local and departmental protectionism must be resolutely resisted and overcome. Local and departmental protectionism are important causes of the "difficulty in enforcement" and must be resolutely resisted and overcome. As state judicial organs, the people's courts must never engage in local or departmental protectionism. For provisions or documents that contradict the law and set obstacles for court enforcement, suggestions shall be promptly submitted to the Party Committee, People's Congress, and government for repeal or abolition. Typical examples of local and departmental protectionism must be promptly provided to disciplinary inspection and supervision organs for investigation and handling.

VIII. Earnestly Conduct Investigation and Research, Timely Summarize Adjudication Experience

In the process of providing judicial guarantees and legal services for maintaining national financial security and comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development, people's courts at all levels must promptly grasp the new situations and new issues arising from changes in the macroeconomic environment.

Adjudication research work must be strengthened, and adjudication experience must be promptly summarized. The ability to predict development trends of various sensitive issues and to effectively resolve difficult and complex issues must be improved. Close attention must be paid to various new situations and new issues arising in the judicial field due to changes in the macroeconomic environment, forward-looking investigations and research must be conducted in depth, and countermeasures and suggestions shall be promptly submitted to relevant departments. Investigation and research on difficult issues of legal application in adjudication work must be strengthened. Based on new changes in the objective situation, and proceeding from promoting economic development and comprehensive social progress, adjudication experience shall be promptly summarized and corresponding countermeasures proposed. When the time is ripe, corresponding judicial policies and judicial interpretations shall be formulated.

Judicial publicity work must be strengthened to give full play to the social guiding role of adjudication work. For influential cases recently concluded involving disruption of the national economy and social stability, extensive publicity shall be conducted in a timely manner through various forms such as holding press conferences, publishing typical cases, and organizing thematic or series reports, to educate and guide various market entities to enhance their awareness of lawful operation and risk prevention, and strive to create a fair and orderly socialist market economic order.

A reporting system for cases involving social stability and major/important cases must be established. For series litigation cases where numerous creditors initiate concentrated lawsuits against the same debtor enterprise, enterprise bankruptcy liquidation cases, class action cases, group cases, and other cases that may have factors affecting social harmony and stability, the filing, adjudication, enforcement, and related business departments of the people's courts at all levels shall promptly report to the court president and the adjudication committee; particularly major cases shall be promptly reported to the higher-level people's court.

Under the increasingly severe international financial and world economic situation, China's economic system reform will enter a new stage of development in broader and deeper fields. The scope of judicial guarantees and legal services that the people's courts must provide for maintaining national financial security and comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable economic development, and the arduousness of the task, will greatly surpass any previous period. People's courts at all levels must further deeply study the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee, persist in deeply studying and practicing the Scientific Outlook on Development, actively practice the guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," further strengthen political awareness, overall situation awareness, and legal awareness, fully exercise their adjudication functions, administer justice impartially and efficiently, and jointly make new and greater contributions to maintaining China's financial security, ensuring the comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable development of China's economy and society, and building a harmonious socialist society.
